why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Luis García Jr. is slot #4 (4.330 expected team runs/game).
Slots #4, #3, #2, #5, #6, #7, #8, #1, #9 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #2 ranks 3 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.001 R/G.
Slot #4 yields 4.32 expected PA/game vs 4.54 at primary slot #2. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
